id.description: Canonical C3 Identifier for this Cloud Resource in the format of <cluster>-<env>-<app>-<func>[-<role>]-<seq>[-<subseq>].

env.description:
C3 Environment name (second) component in {@link #id}; e.g. srv,ui,c3.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> c3
An Environment name must be unique within a Cluster.

app.description:
C3 Application name (third) component in {@link #id}; e.g. c3,crm,lightbulb
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> crm
An Application name must be unique within an Environment.

role.description:
C3 role; e.g. m, w; cannot be number only.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> l

@see CloudResource#cloudRoles

seq.description:
Sequence number - should only contain numbers - it is recommended to have fixed number of digits for a
`<func>-<role>` with 0 left padding so that list of resources are naturally ordered; can be 2, 3, 4 or 5 digits.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> 0001

@see CloudResource#cloudSeqLength

subseq.description:
Sub-sequence alphanumeric string (dot allowed)
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-t-0001-kk03
=> 001

resourceId.description: Cloud service provider generated native ID, such as vpcId and securityGroupId.

resourceSecondaryId.description: Cloud service provider generated native secondary ID, such as Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

resourceName.description: User defined name attribute managed by cloud service provider.

resourceGroupName.description: ResourceGroup for Azure resources and K8s namespaces

fullyConfigured.description:
When true, CloudResource will GET from locally persisted Config framework
When false, CloudResource will GET from remote Cloud APIs

resourceNamespace.description: resourceNamespace for K8s Resources (only those which are associated with a namespace)

external.description:
This flag indicates that this cloud resource managed by third party, C3 will not create or destroy this resource
implicitly.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

nativeMetricByName.description:
This table has logical metrics as keys and native metrics as values.
For example, 'cpu' could map to native metric 'CPUUTILIZATION' for {@link AwsEc2Instance}

tags.description: Cloud tags assigned to this resource.

description.description: Customized description for the cloud resource.

parentResource.description: Parent Cloud Resource that this children cloud resource belongs to

securityGroups.description: The id of the child security groups of the resource.

instanceType.description: Type of the instance such as aws instance type or azure instance vmSize

state.description: Specifies the current state of this database

dbEngine.description: The name of the database engine to be used for this instance. Not modifiable.

dbEngineVersion.description: The version number of the database engine to use.

pendingDbEngineVersion.description: The pending modification of the dbEngineVersion

dbLicenseModel.description: License model information for this DB instance.

dbInstanceClass.description: The compute and memory capacity of the DB instance.

isMultiAz.description: Specifies if the DB instance is a Multi-AZ deployment.

availabilityZone.description: The EC2 Availability Zone that the database instance will be created in. Not modifiable.

storageType.description: Specifies the type of storage devices to be associated with the DB instance.

allocatedStorage.description: The amount of storage (in GB) to be allocated for the database instance.

iops.description:
The amount of Provisioned IOPS (input/output operations per second) to be initially allocated for the DB instance.
It must be a multiple between 3 and 10 of the storage amount for the DB instance, and also be an integer multiple
of 1000.

masterUserName.description: The name of a master user that will connect to the DB instance. Not modifiable.

masterUserPassword.description:
The password of the master user and it can be any printable ASCII character except "/", """, or "@".
If no set here, a random password will be auto-generated and used.

updatingMasterUserPassword.description: Indicate whether the masterUserPassword is being updated

dbSubnetGroupName.description: A DB subnet group to associate with this DB instance.

isNotPubliclyAccessible.description:
Specifies the accessibility options for the DB instance. The default is False.
False specifies an Internet-facing instance with a publicly resolvable DNS name, which resolves to a public IP address.
True specifies an internal instance with a DNS name that resolves to a private IP address.

dbName.description:
The meaning of this parameter differs according to the database engine you use. Not modifiable.
For MySql,
    The name of the database to create when the DB instance is created.
    If this parameter is not specified, no database is created in the DB instance.
For MariaDB,
    The name of the database to create when the DB instance is created.
    If this parameter is not specified, no database is created in the DB instance.
For PostgreSQL,
    The name of the database to create when the DB instance is created.
    If this parameter is not specified, the default "postgres" database is created in the DB instance.
For Oracle,
    The Oracle System ID (SID) of the created DB instance.
For SQL Server,
    Not applicable.

dbPort.description: The port number on which the database accepts connections.

backupRetentionPeriod.description:
The number of days for which automated backups are retained.
Setting this parameter to between 1 and 35 enables backups.
Setting this parameter to 0 disables automated backups.

preferredBackupWindow.description:
The daily time range during which automated backups are created if automated backups are enabled.
Must be in the format hh24:mi-hh24:mi. Times should be in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).
Must not conflict with the preferred maintenance window.
Must be at least 30 minutes.

monitoringInterval.description:
The interval, in seconds, between points when Enhanced Monitoring metrics are collected for the DB instance.
Valid Values: 0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60. The default is 0, which disables collecting Enhanced Monitoring metrics.

monitoringRoleArn.description: The ARN for the IAM role that permits RDS to send enhanced monitoring metrics to CloudWatch Logs

notAutoMinorUpgrade.description: Indicates that minor engine upgrades will be applied automatically to the DB instance. The default is false.

copyTagsToSnapshot.description: Copy all tags from the DB instance to snapshots of the DB instance. The default is false.

preferredMaintenanceWindow.description:
The weekly time range during which system maintenance can occur, in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).
Must be in the format ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi. Times should be in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).
Valid Days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
Must be at least 30 minutes window
